blocks.en: Holmgren's Uniqueness Theorem
blocks.zh: Holmgren 唯一性定理
blocks.label: sec:holmgren-uniqueness

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The theorem in the previous section shows existence and uniqueness of solutions for a noncharacteristic initial-value problem. However, uniqueness was only guaranteed within the class of analytic functions; the existence of other, nonanalytic solutions was not ruled out. Holmgren's theorem shows that this cannot happen for linear equations; we shall prove uniqueness assuming only that the solution is smooth enough so that all derivatives appearing in the partial differential equation are continuous (using the concept of "generalized" solutions, defined later in this book, this assumption can be relaxed further). The proof of uniqueness is achieved by proving existence of solutions for an "adjoint" system of differential equations. To obtain this existence we shall use the Cauchy-Kovalevskaya theorem; this requires us to assume analytic coefficients in the equations. If, however, we had an existence theory which works without analyticity of the coefficients, this assumption would be unnecessary.
blocks.zh: 上一节的定理证明了非特征初值问题解的存在性与唯一性. 但唯一性仅在解析函数类中得到保证, 并未排除其他非解析解的存在. Holmgren 定理说明, 对线性方程, 这种情况不会发生; 这里只假定解足够光滑, 使偏微分方程中出现的所有导数都连续, 就证明唯一性 (利用本书后面定义的"广义"解概念, 还可以进一步放宽这一假设). 唯一性的证明通过证明一个"伴随"微分方程组解的存在性来实现. 为得到这一存在性, 使用 Cauchy-Kovalevskaya 定理, 因而需要假设方程的系数解析. 不过, 如果有一种不要求系数解析的存在性理论, 就不需要这一假设.

blocks.en: The Cauchy-Kovalevskaya theorem guarantees that \eqref{eq:holmgren-adjoint-system} has a solution in a neighborhood of $S$ if the $f_i$ are analytic. Unfortunately, we can in general not claim that this neighborhood includes all of $\Omega$. If it did, we would obtain \eqref{eq:holmgren-boundary-pairing} for analytic $\bm{f}$. The Weierstrass approximation theorem states that any continuous function on a compact subset of $\mathbb{R}^n$ can be approximated uniformly by polynomials. Therefore, if \eqref{eq:holmgren-boundary-pairing} holds for $\bm{f}$ whose components are polynomials, it also holds for continuous $\bm{f}$.
blocks.zh: Cauchy-Kovalevskaya 定理保证, 若 $f_i$ 解析, 则 \eqref{eq:holmgren-adjoint-system} 在 $S$ 的一个邻域内有解. 可惜, 一般不能断言这个邻域包含整个 $\Omega$. 如果它确实包含整个区域, 就能对解析的 $\bm{f}$ 得到 \eqref{eq:holmgren-boundary-pairing}. Weierstrass 逼近定理指出, $\mathbb{R}^n$ 的紧子集上的任意连续函数都可被多项式一致逼近. 因此, 若 \eqref{eq:holmgren-boundary-pairing} 对分量为多项式的 $\bm{f}$ 成立, 它也对连续的 $\bm{f}$ 成立.

blocks.en: Statement and Proof of the Theorem
blocks.zh: 定理的陈述与证明
blocks.label: subsec:holmgren-statement-proof

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
In order to overcome the difficulty that we cannot guarantee a solution of \eqref{eq:holmgren-adjoint-system} throughout all of $\Omega$, we shall replace the surface $S$ by a one-parameter family of surfaces $S_\lambda$ and then take "small steps" in $\lambda$. More precisely, we shall presume the following situation.

Let $D$ be a bounded domain in $\mathbb{R}^n$, such that the coefficients of \eqref{eq:holmgren-linear-first-order-system} are analytic on $D$. Let $Z=D\cap\{x_n=0\}$ and assume that $Z$ is nonempty and noncharacteristic. Let $\Phi(\bm{x})$ be an analytic function defined on $D$ such that $\nabla\Phi\ne0$ and let $S_\lambda=\{\Phi=\lambda\}\cap\{x_n\geq0\}$. We assume there are real numbers $a$ and $b$, $a<b$, such that the following hold:
blocks.zh:
为克服不能保证 \eqref{eq:holmgren-adjoint-system} 在整个 $\Omega$ 内有解这一困难, 将用单参数曲面族 $S_\lambda$ 替代曲面 $S$, 再沿 $\lambda$ 作"小步"推进. 更确切地说, 假定如下情形.

设 $D$ 为 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 中的有界区域, 且 \eqref{eq:holmgren-linear-first-order-system} 的系数在 $D$ 上解析. 令 $Z=D\cap\{x_n=0\}$, 并假设 $Z$ 非空且非特征. 设 $\Phi(\bm{x})$ 为定义在 $D$ 上的解析函数, 满足 $\nabla\Phi\ne0$, 并令 $S_\lambda=\{\Phi=\lambda\}\cap\{x_n\geq0\}$. 假设存在实数 $a$ 和 $b$, $a<b$, 使下列条件成立:

blocks.en: Let $\Omega=\{\bm{x}\in D\mid x_n>0,\ a<\Phi(\bm{x})<b\}$. Let $\bm{u}\in C^1(\overline\Omega)$ be a solution of \eqref{eq:holmgren-linear-first-order-system} such that $\bm{u}=0$ on $\partial\Omega\cap\overline Z$. Then $\bm{u}=0$ in $\overline\Omega$.
blocks.zh: 令 $\Omega=\{\bm{x}\in D\mid x_n>0,\ a<\Phi(\bm{x})<b\}$. 设 $\bm{u}\in C^1(\overline\Omega)$ 是 \eqref{eq:holmgren-linear-first-order-system} 的一个解, 且在 $\partial\Omega\cap\overline Z$ 上 $\bm{u}=0$. 那么在 $\overline\Omega$ 内 $\bm{u}=0$.
blocks.label: thm:holmgren-uniqueness

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: \begin{Proof}Let $\Lambda=\{\lambda\in[a,b]\mid\bm{u}=0\text{ on }S_\lambda\}$. We know that $a\in\Lambda$, and it follows from the continuity of $\bm{u}$ that $\Lambda$ is closed. We shall show that $\Lambda$ is also open in $[a,b]$. This implies $\Lambda=[a,b]$ and hence the theorem.
blocks.zh: \begin{Proof}令 $\Lambda=\{\lambda\in[a,b]\mid\bm{u}=0\text{ on }S_\lambda\}$. 已知 $a\in\Lambda$, 由 $\bm{u}$ 的连续性可得 $\Lambda$ 是闭的. 将证明 $\Lambda$ 在 $[a,b]$ 中也是开的. 由此得到 $\Lambda=[a,b]$, 从而定理成立.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We note that $\overline\Omega$ is compact, and hence there is $M,\rho$, independent of $\bm{x}$, such that $a_{ij}^k$, $b_{ij}$ and $\Phi$ are in $C_{M,\rho}(\bm{x})$ for every $\bm{x}\in\overline\Omega$. Consequently, if Cauchy data of class $C_{M,\rho}$ are prescribed on $S_\mu$, a solution of \eqref{eq:holmgren-adjoint-system} exists in an $\epsilon$-neighborhood of $S_\mu$, with $\epsilon$ independent of $\mu\in(a,b]$. We note that any polynomial lies in some $C_{M,\rho}$, where we can choose $\rho$ as large as we wish, at the expense of making $M$ large. However, \eqref{eq:holmgren-adjoint-system} is linear, and hence the domain on which the solution exists does not change if the Cauchy data are multiplied by a constant factor. Hence the class of Cauchy data for which solutions to \eqref{eq:holmgren-adjoint-system} exist in an $\epsilon$-neighborhood of $S_\mu$ includes all polynomials.
blocks.zh: 注意, $\overline\Omega$ 是紧的, 因而存在不依赖于 $\bm{x}$ 的 $M,\rho$, 使每个 $\bm{x}\in\overline\Omega$ 都有 $a_{ij}^k$, $b_{ij}$ 和 $\Phi$ 属于 $C_{M,\rho}(\bm{x})$. 因此, 若在 $S_\mu$ 上指定 $C_{M,\rho}$ 类的 Cauchy 数据, 则 \eqref{eq:holmgren-adjoint-system} 的解存在于 $S_\mu$ 的一个 $\epsilon$ 邻域内, 其中 $\epsilon$ 不依赖于 $\mu\in(a,b]$. 注意, 任意多项式都属于某个 $C_{M,\rho}$, 其中可以将 $\rho$ 取得任意大, 代价是使 $M$ 也变大. 然而, \eqref{eq:holmgren-adjoint-system} 是线性的, 因而将 Cauchy 数据乘以常数因子, 并不改变解存在的区域. 所以, 使 \eqref{eq:holmgren-adjoint-system} 的解存在于 $S_\mu$ 的一个 $\epsilon$ 邻域内的 Cauchy 数据类包含所有多项式.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We claim that, for given $\lambda\in[a,b]$ and $\epsilon>0$, there is a $\delta>0$ such that $S_\lambda$ is contained in the $\epsilon$-neighborhood of $S_\mu$ whenever $\mu\in[a,b]$ and $|\mu-\lambda|<\delta$. To see this, we first note that, in the neighborhood of any point $\bm{x}\in S_\lambda$, the equation $\Phi(\bm{x})=\mu$ can be solved for one of the coordinates $x_i=x_i(x_1,\ldots,x_{i-1},x_{i+1},\ldots,x_n,\mu)$, and if $\bm{x}\in Z$ and $\lambda\ne a$ we can choose $i\ne n$. If $\lambda=a$, we have to choose $i=n$, and $x_n$ is an increasing function of $\mu$. In all cases, an immediate consequence is that, if $\delta(\bm{x})$ is chosen sufficiently small, then for every $\mu\in[a,b]$ with $|\mu-\lambda|<\delta(\bm{x})$ there is a point $\bm{y}\in S_\mu$ with $|\bm{y}-\bm{x}|<\epsilon/2$. Since $S_\lambda$ is compact, there is a finite number of points $\bm{x}_k$, $k=1,\ldots,K$, such that $S_\lambda$ is covered by the balls centered at $\bm{x}_k$ with radius $\epsilon/2$. The claim then follows with $\delta=\min\delta(\bm{x}_k)$.
blocks.zh: 断言, 对给定的 $\lambda\in[a,b]$ 和 $\epsilon>0$, 存在 $\delta>0$, 使得只要 $\mu\in[a,b]$ 且 $|\mu-\lambda|<\delta$, $S_\lambda$ 就包含在 $S_\mu$ 的 $\epsilon$ 邻域内. 为此, 首先注意, 在任意点 $\bm{x}\in S_\lambda$ 的邻域内, 方程 $\Phi(\bm{x})=\mu$ 都可对某个坐标求解为 $x_i=x_i(x_1,\ldots,x_{i-1},x_{i+1},\ldots,x_n,\mu)$, 而若 $\bm{x}\in Z$ 且 $\lambda\ne a$, 则可选择 $i\ne n$. 若 $\lambda=a$, 则必须选择 $i=n$, 且 $x_n$ 是 $\mu$ 的递增函数. 在所有情形下, 一个直接结论是: 如果 $\delta(\bm{x})$ 取得充分小, 则对每个满足 $|\mu-\lambda|<\delta(\bm{x})$ 的 $\mu\in[a,b]$, 都存在点 $\bm{y}\in S_\mu$, 使 $|\bm{y}-\bm{x}|<\epsilon/2$. 由于 $S_\lambda$ 紧, 存在有限个点 $\bm{x}_k$, $k=1,\ldots,K$, 使以 $\bm{x}_k$ 为中心, 半径为 $\epsilon/2$ 的球覆盖 $S_\lambda$. 取 $\delta=\min\delta(\bm{x}_k)$ 即得断言.

blocks.en: Assume now that $\lambda\in\Lambda$ and $\mu\in(a,b]$ with $|\mu-\lambda|<\delta$, where $\delta$ is as above. We can then apply the argument explained in the previous section to the domain bounded by $S_\lambda$, $S_\mu$ and $Z$. We thus reach the conclusion that $\bm{u}=0$ on $S_\mu$, and hence $\mu\in\Lambda$.\end{Proof}
blocks.zh: 现在假设 $\lambda\in\Lambda$, 且 $\mu\in(a,b]$ 满足 $|\mu-\lambda|<\delta$, 其中 $\delta$ 同上. 那么可以对 $S_\lambda$, $S_\mu$ 和 $Z$ 围成的区域应用上一节解释的论证. 从而得到在 $S_\mu$ 上 $\bm{u}=0$, 因此 $\mu\in\Lambda$.\end{Proof}

blocks.en: The Weierstrass Approximation Theorem
blocks.zh: Weierstrass 逼近定理
blocks.label: subsec:weierstrass-approximation

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In the above proof, we have used the following theorem, known as the Weierstrass approximation theorem.
blocks.zh: 上述证明使用了以下定理, 称为 Weierstrass 逼近定理.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $S$ be a compact subset of $\mathbb{R}^n$ and let $f$ be a continuous function $S\to\mathbb{R}$. Then there is a sequence of polynomials $p_m(\bm{x})$ such that $p_m(\bm{x})\to f(\bm{x})$ uniformly on $S$.
blocks.zh: 设 $S$ 是 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 的紧子集, $f$ 是连续函数 $S\to\mathbb{R}$. 那么存在多项式序列 $p_m(\bm{x})$, 使 $p_m(\bm{x})\to f(\bm{x})$ 在 $S$ 上一致成立.
blocks.label: thm:weierstrass-approximation

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
\begin{Proof}Let $a_i$, $b_i$, $i=1,\ldots,n$ be such that $S\subset P:=\prod_{i=1}^n(a_i,b_i)$. By the extension theorem of Tietze-Urysohn, $f$ can be extended to a continuous function on all of $\mathbb{R}^n$, which agrees with the given function on $S$ and vanishes outside of $P$. (Most good topology texts give a proof of this result.) We shall again call the extended function $f$ and show that $f$ can be approximated by polynomials uniformly on $P$. Without loss of generality, we may assume that $0<a_i<b_i<1$.

We first consider the one-dimensional case, i.e., let $f\in C(\mathbb{R})$ be such that $f=0$ outside the interval $(a,b)$, where $0<a<b<1$. We shall construct a sequence $p_m$ of polynomials such that $p_m\to f$ uniformly on $[a,b]$.
blocks.zh:
\begin{Proof}取 $a_i$, $b_i$, $i=1,\ldots,n$, 使得 $S\subset P:=\prod_{i=1}^n(a_i,b_i)$. 由 Tietze-Urysohn 延拓定理, 可将 $f$ 延拓为整个 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 上的连续函数, 它在 $S$ 上与给定函数相同, 并在 $P$ 外为零. (大多数好的拓扑学教材都给出这一结果的证明.) 仍将延拓后的函数记为 $f$, 并证明 $f$ 可在 $P$ 上被多项式一致逼近. 不失一般性, 可假设 $0<a_i<b_i<1$.

先考虑一维情形, 即设 $f\in C(\mathbb{R})$, 且在区间 $(a,b)$ 外 $f=0$, 其中 $0<a<b<1$. 将构造多项式序列 $p_m$, 使 $p_m\to f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上一致成立.
